stem: The poet uses the simile in these lines to describe —

options.label: F
options.text: the damage the wind has done to the butterfly's wings

options.label: G
options.text: the quickness and fullness of the butterfly's spreading wings

options.label: H
options.text: the colors of the butterfly's new wings

options.label: J
options.text: the size of the butterfly's wings compared to a ship's sails

visual_elements:
Like sails catching a sudden gust
Those frail folded flaps unfurl;
